name: Windrose Dedicated Server (SteamCMD + Wine)
author: community@local
description: Installs Windrose Dedicated Server (Steam AppID 4129620) via SteamCMD and runs WindroseServer.exe under Wine on Linux. Players join via InviteCode in ServerDescription.json.
startup:
bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; cd /home/container; export WINEDEBUG="${WINEDEBUG:--all}"; # Ensure config exists
if [[ ! -f "ServerDescription.json" ]]; then echo "ServerDescription.json missing!"; ls -la; exit 1; fi; # Pre-start patch (type-safe) using python3 (available in wine yolk)
python3 - <<"PY"
import json, os
p = "ServerDescription.json"
with open(p, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    data = json.load(f)

def get(name, default=""):
    return os.environ.get(name, default)

# Apply env overrides
invite = get("INVITE_CODE", data.get("InviteCode", ""))
name = get("SERVER_NAME", data.get("ServerName", ""))
maxp = get("MAX_PLAYERS", data.get("MaxPlayerCount", 4))
proxy = get("P2P_PROXY_ADDRESS", data.get("P2pProxyAddress", ""))

# Boolean parse for PASSWORD_PROTECTED
pp_raw = get("PASSWORD_PROTECTED", str(data.get("IsPasswordProtected", False)))
pp = str(pp_raw).strip().lower() in ("1", "true", "yes", "y", "on")

pw = get("SERVER_PASSWORD", data.get("Password", ""))

# Write back
data["InviteCode"] = invite
data["ServerName"] = name
try:
    data["MaxPlayerCount"] = int(maxp)
except Exception:
    pass
data["P2pProxyAddress"] = proxy
data["IsPasswordProtected"] = bool(pp)
# If not password protected, clear password to reduce confusion
data["Password"] = pw if pp else ""

with open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    json.dump(data, f, indent=2)
PY

# Locate exe (SteamDB shows WindroseServer.exe)
EXE="WindroseServer.exe"; if [[ -f "./${EXE}" ]]; then :; elif [[ -f "./R5/${EXE}" ]]; then EXE="R5/${EXE}"; else echo "ERROR: WindroseServer.exe not found."; find . -maxdepth 3 -type f -iname "WindroseServer*.exe" -print || true; exit 1; fi;

ARGS="-log"; if [[ -n "${BIND_IP:-}" ]]; then ARGS+=" -MULTIHOME=${BIND_IP}"; fi; if [[ -n "${GAME_PORT:-}" ]]; then ARGS+=" -PORT=${GAME_PORT}"; fi; if [[ -n "${QUERY_PORT:-}" ]]; then ARGS+=" -QUERYPORT=${QUERY_PORT}"; fi;

echo "Launching: wine ${EXE} ${ARGS}";
if command -v xvfb-run >/dev/null 2>&1; then xvfb-run -a wine "${EXE}" ${ARGS}; else wine "${EXE}" ${ARGS}; fi'

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

cd /mnt/server

# Install SteamCMD locally into the server directory
if [[ ! -x "./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh" ]]; then
  mkdir -p steamcmd
  echo "Downloading SteamCMD..."
  curl -sSL "https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz" | tar -xz -C steamcmd
fi

# Install Windrose Dedicated Server (Windows Tool) AppID 4129620
./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh \
  +@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows \
  +force_install_dir /mnt/server \
  +login anonymous \
  +app_update 4129620 validate \
  +quit

# Flatten if SteamCMD dropped files into an installdir subfolder
if [[ -d "/mnt/server/Windrose Dedicated Server" ]] && compgen -G "/mnt/server/Windrose Dedicated Server/*" > /dev/null; then
  echo "Detected nested installdir folder; flattening..."
  shopt -s dotglob
  mv "/mnt/server/Windrose Dedicated Server"/* /mnt/server/ || true
  rmdir "/mnt/server/Windrose Dedicated Server" || true
fi

# Create minimal ServerDescription.json before first boot so Wings config parsing won't fail.
if [[ ! -f "/mnt/server/ServerDescription.json" ]]; then
  cat > /mnt/server/ServerDescription.json <<'JSON'
{
  "PersistentServerId": "",
  "InviteCode": "MyServer1",
  "IsPasswordProtected": false,
  "Password": "",
  "ServerName": "Windrose Dedicated Server",
  "WorldIslandId": "",
  "MaxPlayerCount": 4,
  "P2pProxyAddress": ""
}
JSON
fi

echo "Install complete. Start the server; it will generate world save folders under R5/Saved/..."

variables.description: true/false — require a password to join. (Applied at runtime by python prestart.)
